user.title: Grand Marquee
user.description: Adds a glass-styled scrolling marquee card to your dashboards and a sensor that holds its messages.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Grand Marquee is already set up.

add_message.name: Add message
add_message.description: Add a message to the marquee. Re-using an id replaces that message.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Remove the message automatically after this long.

id.name: ID
id.description: Optional id, so you can replace or remove it later.

id.name: ID
id.description: Id of the message to remove.

clear_messages.name: Clear messages
clear_messages.description: Remove every message from the marquee.

messages.name: Messages
messages.description: List of strings or message objects.

init.title: News for the marquee
init.description: Pick the headlines the marquee's News source can show. Topics come from Google News in your Home Assistant language and country. You can also add any RSS or Atom feed, one address per line. Then choose which of these each marquee shows in its card settings.

data.custom_feeds: Extra feeds (one web address per line)

error.invalid_feed: Each feed must be a full web address starting with http:// or https://.
